purpose: UI design exploration only; not installed application screenshots

variants.name: 浅色专业工作台
variants.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create one exceptionally polished, implementable desktop application UI design proposal for a Chinese Git practice product named "Git Onboarding". Flat front-facing screenshot only, no laptop, no perspective, no surrounding scene. Landscape canvas about 1600x1100. This is an actual working exercise screen, NOT a marketing landing page, dashboard of metrics, or concept poster. Users include complete beginners, people stuck in collaboration, and people afraid of recovery commands. Full real Bash terminal AND editable README must both be prominent and usable. The old design felt cheap due to weak hierarchy, too many pale bordered boxes, tiny thin text, large unproductive blank areas, and no clear action feedback. Redesign completely with meticulous grid, meaningful whitespace, strong text contrast, coordinated Chinese typography and a real desktop product aesthetic. All Chinese should be crisp simplified Chinese sans serif, with intentional regular/medium/semibold weights. Body equivalent to 16px/25px, labels 14px minimum, heading 28px. Use consistent hand-designed simple line icons, not emoji.
Same real scenario for comparison across proposals: lesson "你的第一次提交", mode "独立挑战", branch main, learner has modified README.md and successfully committed. Editor content exactly: "# Git 学习手册" blank line "学习从这里开始。" blank line "大家好！". Terminal contains actual readable commands: "$ git add README.md", "$ git commit -m \"第一次提交\"", "[main 11a701f] 第一次提交", "1 file changed, 2 insertions(+)", "$ git status", "nothing to commit, working tree clean", then an empty prompt. Represent only two commits if showing graph: b3dab59 followed by 11a701f. Navigation courses "第一次提交", "协作与冲突", "撤销与恢复". No fake charts, scores, AI assistant, avatars, gamification, or remote GitHub setup.
Most important interaction: show the result of deliberately clicking "检查练习结果", visibly labeled "检查结果", "本关已完成", "2 / 2 条件通过", checks "README 修改已提交" and "工作区与暂存区干净", proof "提交 11a701f", subtle "刚刚检查". The PRIMARY action after completion must be "下一关：协作与冲突"; secondary small action "再次检查". Do not leave a gigantic meaningless check button as only call to action. The result must be obvious, contain evidence, and guide a next step. Render only this single application screen per image.
Direction A: A quiet, precise professional Windows workbench designed with the clarity and finish of a bespoke premium developer tool. White #FFFFFF workspace, cool soft grey #F3F5F8 navigation, very dark blue-grey #202937 text, disciplined cobalt #345DDB accent, success #287B61 used only for passed states. No green brand sidebar, no gradients, no glass, no gratuitous shadows. Use Noto Sans SC/Source Han Sans style Chinese and carefully spaced geometric Latin product lettering, JetBrains Mono style command text. A restrained 190px left course navigation on light background; compact top header with course title and mode switch. The task objective is a short horizontal content block ABOVE the working area, not a tall empty sidebar. Main working area has a spacious white README editor above a graphite dark terminal, together about 68% width. On the right, a 30% integrated inspector with tabs "仓库状态" and "提交图", a refined small actual Git state/commit visualization, then a highly legible completed-check result panel with the next-lesson primary cobalt button. Minimize container chrome, use alignment and genuine panel boundaries. No stack of identical cards. Moderately rounded interactive controls only. Functional hierarchy, precise 8px spacing rhythm, comfortable dense professional typography. Make the result panel and editor truly elegant rather than adding decoration.

Direction B: A premium night-mode command workspace, materially DIFFERENT information architecture from a conventional sidebar IDE. Calm layered deep desaturated navy #17212E and #202C3A surfaces, near-white #E5ECF4 primary text, restrained steel blue #719CDD accent, muted aqua for Git additions, warm amber only for contextual hints. Chinese typography compact but substantial Source Han Sans style, terminal commands readable JetBrains Mono at 16px/26px, headings 26px medium.
Use horizontal top navigation with the three courses as understated text tabs and a compact lesson header, NO tall full-height left sidebar. Below header a concise mission strip. Central-left 60% of width is an expansive REAL Bash terminal with approximately 16 generous visible lines, resizable split affordance. Right 40% is a README file editor above a settled inline check-results tray, not a modal covering the terminal. The result tray displays the proof, two checks and a strong next lesson action. A thin bottom information rail shows "main", "工作区干净", and "11a701f". Make dark surfaces differentiated through luminance and layout rather than rows of heavy cards. Show deliberate comfortable empty terminal space, avoid wasted explanatory columns. Design for a learner who wants to focus on actual commands, with help secondary but reachable via a small "查看提示" text button. High craft, precise interactive affordances, quietly technical and premium.

Direction C: An approachable, carefully crafted learning workspace; visually mature, clear, encouraging and unusually legible. NOT corporate admin dashboard and NOT a childish game. Pure white workspace with a very subtle pale blue #F2F7FA background, dark ink #23303C text, petrol blue #236985 primary accent and small warm honey #D5A547 highlights for current learning stages. No warm cream/serif/terracotta template, no cartoon mascot, no beige cards or stock illustrations. Architecture DIFFERENT from A and B: clean horizontal top product navigation, no permanent vertical navigation; left-aligned large lesson title and one-sentence mission. A single meaningful horizontal three-stage Git journey strip "修改文件" -> "放入暂存区" -> "创建提交", all three visibly completed, thin elegant connectors and a tiny commit node. This is the only distinctive graphic and explains the Git concept. Below, two balanced equal-width working panes: left README editor, right full dark Bash terminal, each substantial about 450px height, unified in a shared work surface with modest corners. Under both panes, a full-width horizontal completion review region with left "本关已完成" plus two explicit criteria, middle "提交 11a701f" evidence, right prominent "下一关：协作与冲突" button and subtle "再次检查".
